about_the_game:
*So you want a 1v1 experience? A combination of a platformer and a fighting game? Well you are in the right place! Welcome to The Blueppers Mayhem where we don't take things to seriosly... after all, you are in the Void City the place where all the clishes and the mistakes live in, under the tree of the Multi-Multiverse, where all the Brands you know live in separate universes...

*Now about gameplay. So as you have read it is a 1v1 fighting game and the maps are bigger for more freedom in movement. The goal of the gamemode "Game Robbery" is to get a kill. After that a game will spawn around the map and you will need to colect it. As soon as you are carring the game try to get to your basket and stand near it for 4 seconds to score a point. First player which gets 3 games wins.

*The progresion is split in two parts:

*Juicy zaps - reward only available by end of the match or by promotions which result from playing matches. These are used for upgrading your characters to unlock slots, to buy clisher packs, to buy Rare Prints and to buy Overcharges.

*Dimes - reward from promotions as said before, but also through real money. With these you can do everything said up with two diffrences. You can not upgrade your chracters with juicy zaps so you have no slots for Upgrades and also you can buy with dimes only, Tags which are a cosmetic to express your emotions.

*So, in the end, in order to level up your chracters you need juciy zaps even if you spend money but they are unbuyable through real money. So here is the first ever implemetension of a P2W WALL which is nor Pay to win it is actually Play to Win! In exchange dimes have really good values if you want to get some through your beloved cradit card...

*There is not a really complex story yet, though I have a question for you. How did Blueppers break his display? And how did Scarrlet get her scar? Well... nobody knows, yet...

*There are some goals in this game:

1. Promote all your characters! -by winning games from matches with each clisher;

2.Get all Tags! -each has a unique way of unlocking them get in the game and you will see!

3.Upgrade your clishers and get all the Upgrades (Rare Prints and Overcharges).

The jurney will be hard and you will rage but after a while you will become the master of....

T.B.M. ~THE BLUEPPERS MAYHEM!~

  • Processor: Intel Core M or Apple M1
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any integrated graphics card
